name: Auto Computation - Holidays Management (View, Add & Delete)

parameters.query:
={{ $json.action === 'ADD' ? `
INSERT INTO holidays (
  id, name, date, day, type, description, is_office_closed
) VALUES (
  'hol-' || '` + $json.date + `',
  '` + $json.name.replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  '` + $json.date + `'::DATE,
  '` + ($json.day || 'Holiday').replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  '` + ($json.type || 'PUBLIC') + `',
  '` + ($json.description || '').replace(/'/g, "''") + `',
  ` + ($json.isOfficeClosed ? 'TRUE' : 'FALSE') + `
)
ON CONFLICT (date) DO UPDATE SET
  name = EXCLUDED.name,
  day = EXCLUDED.day,
  type = EXCLUDED.type,
  description = EXCLUDED.description,
  is_office_closed = EXCLUDED.is_office_closed
RETURNING 
  id,
  name,
  date::TEXT AS date,
  day,
  type,
  description,
  is_office_closed AS "isOfficeClosed";
` : $json.action === 'DELETE' ? `
DELETE FROM holidays 
WHERE id = '` + $json.holidayId + `'
   OR date::TEXT = '` + $json.holidayId + `'
RETURNING id;
` : `
SELECT 
  id,
  name,
  date::TEXT AS date,
  day,
  type,
  description,
  is_office_closed AS "isOfficeClosed"
FROM holidays
ORDER BY date ASC;
` }}
